title: Lode Runner: The Legend Returns
native_title: ロードランナー レジェンドリターンズ
overview:
Lode Runner: The Legend Returns brings back the classic action puzzle of gold and digging. In each level, gather every piece of treasure and reach the exit while the Mad Monks give chase. Blast holes in the ground to open a path, and think a few moves ahead to find the route that grabs all the loot.

This edition expands the formula with new tools such as drills, bombs and other gadgets, plus teleporters that whisk you across the stage. Levels are spread across a range of themed worlds, each with its own look.

- Treasure-gathering puzzle action across many levels
- New tools and teleporters
- Two-player play, including cooperative levels
- Level editor for building your own stages
